WHO WE ARE
OUR FOUNDERS ARE BUILDING PETROBIND FOR REAL PARTNERSHIPS.

PetroBind markets and sources bitumen, oxidized bitumen, bitumen emulsion, and polymer-modified binders. Our whole pitch comes down to one thing: a quote should reflect the real cost of the material and its route, and it should be quoted per RFQ against your requirement.

Before a buyer commits, we aim to have checked the grade, the typical test values, the packing, and the route. We'd rather do that work upfront than explain a problem after the shipment's left.

WHAT WE DO

Four capabilities behind every RFQ.

SUPPLIER NETWORK

Multiple qualified supply paths for penetration, viscosity, oxidized, PMB, and emulsion grades.

PRINCIPAL TRADING

Commercial sourcing, quotation, documentation, freight, and import support through one accountable desk.

GRADE MATCHING

RFQ review by penetration, viscosity, softening point, packaging, and destination requirements.

EXPORT PACKING

Drums, bags, IBCs, bitutainers, flexibags, and bulk options where suitable.

OUR CORE VALUES

The operating principles behind PetroBind's import-focused bitumen desk.

PROCUREMENT CONFIDENCE

Certificate of Analysis (COA) and Product Data Sheet (PDS) support helps buyers specify, compare, and qualify material before shipment.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITY

PetroBind works as a principal supplier and trader, managing the commercial sourcing path rather than acting as a loose referral desk.

SPECIFICATION-LED SOURCING

We align RFQs to grade, destination, packaging, and recognized ASTM, ISO, and project test-method requirements.

Work With PetroBind
PETROBIND METHOD
FROM RFQ TO QUALIFIED SHIPMENT
01
RFQ REVIEW

We review product type, grade, quantity, destination port, incoterm, documentation needs, and target shipment window.

02
SOURCE MATCHING

PetroBind identifies suitable available lots across penetration bitumen, viscosity grades, PMB, oxidized bitumen, and emulsions.

03
QUALIFICATION

COA and PDS values are reviewed against recognized ASTM, ISO, EN, or project-specific test method references before the buyer approves the lot.

04
IMPORT SUPPORT

Once confirmed, we coordinate packing, export documentation, freight planning, and shipment communication through delivery.

READY TO SHIP

Grade, packing, and documentation are reviewed with the supplier before a quotation goes out — not after.

RFQ
LET'S BUILD YOUR NEXT INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECT TOGETHER.

Tell PetroBind your grade, quantity, destination port, and incoterm. Our export desk aims to reply within one business day with pricing, packing options, lead times, and indicative typical values.
